say:3:1320314001:1.text: What do you want?! Can't you see I'm in the middle of collecting a debt? Get lost!
say:3:1320314001:1.source_cn: 找我干嘛？没看见我正忙着催债吗！去去去！

say:4:1320314002:1.text: Pay up, Levski! Evgeny! Get out here and pay up! I know you're in there!!!
say:4:1320314002:1.source_cn: ——还钱！列夫斯基，老叶甫根尼，快出来！我知道你们在家！！

say:5:1320314003:1.text: Quit shouting! Levski is ill and needs rest!
say:5:1320314003:1.source_cn: 别喊了！列夫斯基还在养病呢！

say:6:1320314004:1.text: Seriously, everyone's already said they're broke. What's the point of all this yelling?
say:6:1320314004:1.source_cn: 是啊！而且周围这么多人都说他们家没钱了，你没听到吗？

say:7:1320314005:1.text: Are you their relatives, or just some wannabe heroes trying to play the savior?
say:7:1320314005:1.source_cn: ……你们又是从哪冒出来的？这么替他们说话，是他们的亲戚？

say:8:1320314006:1.text: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.
say:8:1320314006:1.source_cn: 要不然，你替他们把钱还上？只要拿到钱，我立刻就走，绝不废话。
say:8:1320314006:1.male: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.
say:8:1320314006:1.female: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.

choice_prompt:9:1320314006.text: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.
choice_prompt:9:1320314006.source_cn: 要不然，你替他们把钱还上？只要拿到钱，我立刻就走，绝不废话。
choice_prompt:9:1320314006.male: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.
choice_prompt:9:1320314006.female: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.

say:10:1320314007:1.text: Then you shouldn't be meddling here!
say:10:1320314007:1.source_cn: 不是亲戚？那你就别在这多管闲事！
say:10:1320314007:1.male: Then you shouldn't be meddling here!
say:10:1320314007:1.female: Then you shouldn't be meddling here!

say:11:1320314009:1.text: Plus, the deadline to pay has already passed. I've given them more than enough chances. I can't keep letting this drag on!
say:11:1320314009:1.source_cn: 再说了，原本约定的还钱时间早就过了，我都宽限他们好几次...
say:11:1320314009:1.male: Plus, the deadline to pay has already passed. I've given them more than enough chances. I can't keep letting this drag on!
say:11:1320314009:1.female: Plus, the deadline to pay has already passed. I've given them more than enough chances. I can't keep letting this drag on!

choice_prompt:12:1320314009.text: Plus, the deadline to pay has already passed. I've given them more than enough chances. I can't keep letting this drag on!
choice_prompt:12:1320314009.source_cn: 再说了，原本约定的还钱时间早就过了，我都宽限他们好几次了，再拖下去就有点不厚道了吧？！
choice_prompt:12:1320314009.male: Plus, the deadline to pay has already passed. I've given them more than enough chances. I can't keep letting this drag on!
choice_prompt:12:1320314009.female: Plus, the deadline to pay has already passed. I've given them more than enough chances. I can't keep letting this drag on!

say:13:1320314010:1.text: Hmph, it's easy for you to say that since you're not the one owed money!
say:13:1320314010:1.source_cn: 哼，被欠钱不还的人又不是你，你说得自然轻松。
say:13:1320314010:1.male: Hmph, it's easy for you to say that since you're not the one owed money!
say:13:1320314010:1.female: Hmph, it's easy for you to say that since you're not the one owed money!

say:14:1320314012:1.text: C'mon, money doesn't grow on trees! I need my money back for my own business!
say:14:1320314012:1.source_cn: 谁的钱也不是大风刮来的，我做生意还等着用呢！
say:14:1320314012:1.male: C'mon, money doesn't grow on trees! I need my money back for my own business!
say:14:1320314012:1.female: C'mon, money doesn't grow on trees! I need my money back for my own business!

say:15:1320314013:1.text: If you're not going to pay for them, then stop getting in my way! Or else... don't say I didn't warn you!
say:15:1320314013:1.source_cn: 你要是不准备替他还钱，就别在这儿碍我的事！要不然的话…...
say:15:1320314013:1.male: If you're not going to pay for them, then stop getting in my way! Or else... don't say I didn't warn you!
say:15:1320314013:1.female: If you're not going to pay for them, then stop getting in my way! Or else... don't say I didn't warn you!

choice_prompt:16:1320314013.text: If you're not going to pay for them, then stop getting in my way! Or else... don't say I didn't warn you!
choice_prompt:16:1320314013.source_cn: 你要是不准备替他还钱，就别在这儿碍我的事！要不然的话……哼，别怪我用一些非常手段！
choice_prompt:16:1320314013.male: If you're not going to pay for them, then stop getting in my way! Or else... don't say I didn't warn you!
choice_prompt:16:1320314013.female: If you're not going to pay for them, then stop getting in my way! Or else... don't say I didn't warn you!

say:17:1320314014:1.text: You...! If it weren't for those two rats beside you, I'd take you down myself!
say:17:1320314014:1.source_cn: 你、你……！要不是你身边有那两只耗子，我才不会放过你！
say:17:1320314014:1.male: You...! If it weren't for those two rats beside you, I'd take you down myself!
say:17:1320314014:1.female: You...! If it weren't for those two rats beside you, I'd take you down myself!

say:18:1320314015:1.text: Hmph! Just you wait! I'll teach you and Levski a lesson soon!
say:18:1320314015:1.source_cn: 哼，等着瞧吧，我趁早要把你和列夫斯基都教训一顿！
say:18:1320314015:1.male: Hmph! Just you wait! I'll teach you and Levski a lesson soon!
say:18:1320314015:1.female: Hmph! Just you wait! I'll teach you and Levski a lesson soon!

choice:16:1:2.text: Do you think you can take me?
choice:16:1:2.male: Do you think you can take me?
choice:16:1:2.female: Do you think you can take me?

say:20:1320314011:1.text: That's true... but my interest rates aren't high; I'm barely making anything!
say:20:1320314011:1.source_cn: 话是这么说……但我给他们的利率也不高，根本没什么赚头！
say:20:1320314011:1.male: That's true... but my interest rates aren't high; I'm barely making anything!
say:20:1320314011:1.female: That's true... but my interest rates aren't high; I'm barely making anything!

say:21:1320314008:1.text: I'd rather not raise my voice, but they refuse to come out!
say:21:1320314008:1.source_cn: 我也不想扯着嗓子喊，但谁让他们躲在房子里不出来呢！
say:21:1320314008:1.male: I'd rather not raise my voice, but they refuse to come out!
say:21:1320314008:1.female: I'd rather not raise my voice, but they refuse to come out!

choice:9:1:2.text: I just can't stand your yelling!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 我只是看不下去你在这大吵大闹！
choice:9:1:2.male: I just can't stand your yelling!
choice:9:1:2.female: I just can't stand your yelling!
